summary: Eltek Ltd., an Israeli printed circuit board maker listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K on October 6, 2026, reporting receipt of $6.8 million in follow-on purchase orders from an unnamed international customer, with delivery scheduled across 2027 and 2028. The filing is a routine commercial-update press release, not a corporate transaction. Chief Executive Officer Ron Freund is named and quoted; no financial advisor, board recommendation, or special-situation mechanics are present. The orders lift backlog to a record, supporting production planning but leaving customer concentration and geopolitical risk unaddressed.
